scope: Source-checkout alpha; current task compiler and known synthetic regression suite.
initial_retrieval: Provider-local BM25 top 20 over pinned official operation text; no hand-authored endpoint catalog.
adaptive_budget: At most two expansion/replanning passes; at most 12 operations per task and 16 new schema reads per task per pass; at most one complete-directory fallback.
admission: Shared validation runs during repair and before marking a compilation completed. It validates structure, documented operations and fields, pagination, phase references, context and response dependencies, and explicit typed-preservation policy. It does not prove task interpretation is semantically exhaustive.
quantity_policy: Existing-item price-only Stripe invoice previews explicitly preserve the observed integer quantity of the identified subscription item. This is a reviewed provider policy, not an automatically discovered universal rule.
inference: Signed-in Codex CLI; tools, web and apps disabled. Each stage permits one retry for an operational failure, never a completed answer rejected by a private grade. Each attempt has a 240-second timeout.
regression: Six known tasks and 41 simulated scenarios, developed by the same author; not blinded or a production reliability benchmark.
storage: Pinned specifications and pagination guidance are compressed. Immutable content-addressed gzip blobs retain payloads and provenance; SQLite stores watch, deduplication and outbox references. External cache and runtime records stay ignored under data/.
